Quick edit about Umbralocht magic study habits. The '50 years' was a general guideline assuming average human-level intellect and learning capacity, so it can be pushed up or down a bit based on individual talent and if a race is particularily intelligent/masters things quickly naturally. Also, this study can theoretically begin very early in life - it's basically actively obsessing over something to the point of mastering that thing, which doesn't require, say, a formal education before you can start it. So, master mages may be as young as 40 if they are especially talented and started early, or like 55-60 in a more typical case. Gifted mages can potentially master as many as 2 or 3 things in their lifetime, having mastered the first at ~40, the second at ~70, and the third at ~100. This is kind of a edge case hypothetical prodigy, and assumes human life-cycle and intelligence. Even average mages that live long enough can master 2 by the end of their lives - assuming, of course, they haven't burned their bodies away by that point - mastering several umbralocht magics doesn't stack well, unfortunately, although mastering a first probably gives one the opportunity to master the rare 'recursive' magic mastery of 'Magic itself,' which has been mentioned in an older post by {...}.
